current_answer: AWS Activate Portfolio needs a provider-issued, case-sensitive Org ID and provider verification; it is not an automatic USD 200,000 award. Use a company-domain email consistently in the Activate profile and application. Self-funded founders use the separate Founders route, which starts at USD 1,000 if approved. Microsoft startup credits cannot be extended, and its new-to-Azure offer is not a renewal. NLnet still lists a live 3 November, 12:00 CET form; Interledger Local Impact remains paused.

catalogue_card.question: Have an AWS Activate provider code?
catalogue_card.text: Portfolio can reach USD 200,000, but a provider must issue the case-sensitive Org ID and verify your affiliation. Self-funded founders use the separate USD 1,000-starting route; neither amount is an automatic award.

summary: AWS Portfolio needs a provider-issued, case-sensitive Org ID, matching business email and provider affiliation verification before an award decision.
AWS Founders is the direct self-funded route; it starts at USD 1,000 if approved, with up to USD 5,000 only for selected participants.
Microsoft credits cannot be extended. NLnet lists a live 3 November form; Interledger Local Impact remains paused.
uncertainty: AWS does not publish every provider verification step or applicant-specific Portfolio allocation.
The reviewed AWS pages do not settle country availability or awarded-credit validity.
Microsoft no-code starter guides still conflict on USD 200 versus USD 1,000; verify the live account before spending.
